description: This file defines FastAPI route handlers for managing packing list items within a travel planning application. It includes endpoints for retrieving, creating, updating (toggling packed status), and deleting packing items associated with trips. The code interacts with database models and schemas, and enforces access control via dependencies.

methods.name: PackingItemResponse _item_to_response(item: PackingItem)
methods.description: Converts a PackingItem ORM object into a PackingItemResponse schema for API responses.

methods.name: get_packing_list( trip_id: str, current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user), db: Session = Depends(get_db), )
methods.description: Retrieves the packing list for a specific trip, including associated items.

methods.name: create_packing_item( trip_id: str, payload: PackingItemPayload, current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user), db: Session = Depends(get_db), )
methods.description: Creates a new packing item for a specific trip based on provided payload.

methods.name: toggle_packing_item( trip_id: str, item_id: str, payload: TogglePackedRequest, current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user), db: Session = Depends(get_db), )
methods.description: Toggles the 'is_packed' status of a specified packing item.

methods.name: delete_packing_item( trip_id: str, item_id: str, current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user), db: Session = Depends(get_db), )
methods.description: Deletes a specified packing item from the trip.

ctags.signature: ( trip_id: str, payload: PackingItemPayload, current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user), db: Session = Depends(get_db), )

ctags.signature: ( trip_id: str, item_id: str, current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user), db: Session = Depends(get_db), )
